name: BrowserPair
tagline: Use your signed-in Chrome with user permissions and verified results
description: BrowserPair connects Cline to the user's own signed-in Chrome via Streamable HTTP MCP. Read page content, navigate, fill forms, and verify authorized actions. OAuth 2.1/PKCE, user-controlled browser grants and permissions apply. Requires a BrowserPair account and the paired Chrome extension. Details: https://docs.browserpair.com/connect-ai-app.

install.notes: Connect with BrowserPair OAuth in Cline, pair Chrome via the BrowserPair extension, select the authorized browser and run browser_list. Sensitive actions still require appropriate permissions. Privacy: https://browserpair.com/privacy.
